# directus_access (Data Source)

Reads a Directus access record (directus_access) by id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the access record to look up.

### Read-Only

- `policy` (String) UUID of the assigned policy.
- `role` (String) UUID of the role the policy is assigned to (null for user assignments).
- `sort` (Number) Manual sort order of the assignment.
- `user` (String) UUID of the user the policy is assigned to (null for role assignments).
